rationale: Use one outlined navigation geometry for the header close action instead of a separately painted absolute child and border wrapper. Scope a 40px colour trigger to the Background toolbar so single-row editor toolbars share the existing 57px height; preserve intrinsic wrapping and popup behaviour.

summary.ru: Выровнены верхний крестик редактора и высота панелей трёх редакторов.
summary.en: Align the header close action and the three editor toolbar heights.
